purpose: SEMANTIC_ENTROPY_SUFFICIENCY_GATE exploratory causal test -- responds to ResearchOS candidate rmc-2026-08-24-001 and AAMR's own research request arr-2026-08-24-001 (GAP-005), following a positive $0-cost calibration (data/lab/arena/semantic-entropy-sufficiency-calibration-v1/calibration.json: mean entropy sufficient=0.300 vs insufficient=1.104, separation +0.804, clean and in the theoretically expected direction on 8 already-known-labeled units).
excludes_note: all 85 units used or examined anywhere in this arena to date (every prior mechanism's selection.json, recursively globbed, including the 8 units reused for the semantic-entropy calibration itself, which were already part of raw-provenance-fresh-replication-v1's own selection and thus already excluded). _abs variants excluded by base id too.

selection_rule.method: 1 unit per LongMemEval-S category (6 categories), first-by-question_id-sort within category after exclusion. Unweighted -- this candidate's target (compact-vs-raw sufficiency, gated by sample-disagreement) is not category-specific by design.
selection_rule.size_note: 6 units -- appropriately lean for a first exploratory causal test given remaining campaign budget (~$1.04 of $5.00 hard cap at preregistration time, past the $3.00 preferred threshold).
